fop_lodge_9.name: Charlotte-Mecklenburg Fraternal Order of Police Lodge #9
fop_lodge_9.description: The largest FOP lodge in North Carolina, serving as the voice of more than 4,500 active and retired law enforcement officers, deputy sheriffs, detention officers, state troopers, and administrative professionals across Charlotte-Mecklenburg.

moms_demand_action.name: Moms Demand Action for Gun Sense in America
moms_demand_action.description: A grassroots movement of Americans fighting for public safety measures that can protect people from gun violence, passing stronger gun laws, closing loopholes, and encouraging a culture of responsible gun ownership.

secrc_carpenters.name: Southeastern Carpenters Regional Council (Southern RCC)
secrc_carpenters.description: Affiliated with the United Brotherhood of Carpenters, representing thousands of skilled union carpenters, millwrights, and pile drivers across the Southeast, championing fair wages, workplace safety, and professional apprentice training.

seiu_airport_workers.name: SEIU Airport Workers Rising (Airport Workers United)
seiu_airport_workers.description: A movement led by 32BJ SEIU organizing baggage handlers, cabin cleaners, wheelchair agents, fuelers, and janitors demanding living wages, affordable healthcare, and safe working conditions at Charlotte Douglas International Airport.

charlotte_firefighters.name: Charlotte Fire Fighters Association (IAFF Local 660)
charlotte_firefighters.description: Representing the dedicated professional firefighters and emergency responders protecting the City of Charlotte, advocating for public safety, firefighter wellness, safety equipment, and fair working conditions.

equality_nc.name: Equality North Carolina
equality_nc.description: The nation's oldest statewide organization committed to securing full rights, non-discrimination protections, and equality for LGBTQ+ individuals and marginalized communities across North Carolina.

ncaat_in_action.name: North Carolina Asian Americans Together in Action (NCAATIA)
ncaat_in_action.description: Dedicated to building towards a better future for North Carolina by engaging Asian Americans in targeted civic action, defending democracy, and promoting equitable policies across the state.

indian_american_impact.name: Indian American Impact
indian_american_impact.description: Empowering South Asian and Indian American communities through civic engagement, partnerships, candidate support, and data & research in order to encourage a pro-democracy government that uplifts all people.

charlotte_post.name: The Charlotte Post
charlotte_post.description: Serving as a dominant voice in educating, empowering, and enlightening Charlotte's African American community for over 147 years, tracing its roots back to 1878.

sierra_club.name: Sierra Club — North Carolina Chapter
sierra_club.description: Advocating for a clean, healthy environment and the well-being of all who live in North Carolina from the mountains to the coast, focusing on climate action, clean energy transition, pollution control, and public land preservation.

black_political_caucus.name: Black Political Caucus of Charlotte-Mecklenburg
black_political_caucus.description: Established in the early 1970s to provide a unified voice for the Black community in local politics, increasing political awareness, advocating for equity and justice, and evaluating candidates across Mecklenburg County.

unite_here.name: UNITE HERE!
unite_here.description: A North American labor union representing over 300,000 working people in hotel, gaming, food service, manufacturing, laundry, and airport concession industries fighting for good union jobs.

charlotte_observer.name: The Charlotte Observer
charlotte_observer.description: The major daily newspaper and primary regional news source for the Charlotte metropolitan area and the Carolinas since 1886.

dimple_ajmera_campaign.name: Dimple Ajmera for Charlotte City Council At-Large
dimple_ajmera_campaign.description: Official campaign for Council Member Dimple Ajmera, working mother, Certified Public Accountant, and dedicated public servant fighting for Charlotte families.
